name: Example Concept Name
summary: A 2–3 sentence explanation of this concept that is detailed enough for an AI to generate both multiple-choice and free-response quiz questions from. Include the key mechanism, definition, or principle. Include any important nuances or common misconceptions worth testing.

name: Second Concept Name
summary: Another concept summary following the same format. Aim for enough specificity that a quiz question cannot be answered by general knowledge alone — it should require familiarity with this particular material.

name: First Concept in Module 2
summary: Concepts from a second module follow the same structure. The module and lesson fields in scope are used by /quizinit to filter questions by scope — e.g. /quizinit module "Module 2" will only draw from concepts where scope.module matches.
